returns.salt: Salt used for CREATE2 address derivation of the proxy.

returns.facetAddresses: Deployed facet addresses (immutable after pkg construction).

returns.facetCuts_: The cuts to pass to DiamondCut.

facetInterfaces().details: ONLY interfaces expected to be called through the proxy (not direct calls on the pkg itself).

returns.interfaces: Array of interface IDs registered on deployed Diamond proxies.

initAccount(bytes).details: The DiamondPackageCallBackFactory calls this after creating the proxy and applying cuts.Implementations typically decode args, perform cuts via IDiamondCut, call own _initialize etc.

params.initArgs: ABI-encoded initialization data (derived from processed pkgArgs).

postDeploy(address).details: Can be used for wiring external references, emitting events, or additional setup.TODO: Consider returning bytes for richer post-deploy results.

returns._0: success True if post-deploy completed successfully.

processArgs(bytes).details: May return args unchanged. Used to derive salt distinctly from init state.

returns.processedPkgArgs: Arguments to use for salt calc and later initAccount.

params.expectedProxy: The proxy address expected to be updated (safety check).

calcSalt(bytes).notice: Computes the deterministic salt for proxy deployment given package args.

deployCreate3Factory(address).notice: Deploys a fully configured Create3Factory Diamond proxy (with supporting facets).

diamondConfig().notice: Convenience method returning both cuts and interfaces in a single struct.

facetAddresses().notice: Returns the addresses of the facet contracts referenced by this package.

facetCuts().notice: Returns the facet cuts (add/replace/remove) to apply when deploying a proxy from this package.

facetInterfaces().notice: Returns ERC165 interface IDs that THIS package's logic exposes when attached to a proxy.

initAccount(bytes).notice: Standardized initialization entrypoint called via delegatecall on the new proxy during deployment.

packageMetadata().notice: Returns combined metadata for the package in one call.

packageName().notice: Returns the human-readable name of this package.

postDeploy(address).notice: Optional post-deployment hook called after initAccount.

processArgs(bytes).notice: Optional preprocessing hook to normalize or decorate user-provided arguments.

updatePkg(address,bytes).notice: Allows updating package configuration for an already-deployed proxy (if supported).
